title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a scorching China Cat > Rider, emotive Sailor→Saint and Brent’s vibrant organ work; recording is generally good enough to enjoy.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the fiery first‑set China Cat > Rider and a second set sparked by To Lay Me Down, highlighting Brent Mydland's frenzied organ and vocal texture. The Sailor→Saint sequence is noted as especially moving, and the post‑drums segment rounds out an overall strong performance. No specific recording flaws are mentioned, suggesting the tape is clear and listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are 4‑5 stars praising musical moments; no complaints about audio quality, so a solid rating near the high end of good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not note any sound issues, implying the recording is clear enough for enjoyment.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds momentum to a hot China Cat > Rider; second set lifts off with To Lay Me Down and maintains high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s grainy voice and frenzied organ playing are highlighted as enlivening the performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Post‑drums sequence is mentioned as a highlight, though no specific comments on drumming quality.
